hold_reason: Refund mismatch: Alpha Co's handoff reports three refunds applied (order 102: 2289, order 103: 12232, order 105: 33575), but list_refunds shows only order 102 (2289) and order 105 (33575). Alpha's refund work needs to be completed or corrected before payouts proceed. No payouts have been recorded.
